body:
## Release v2.0.6 - Full Code Restructuring

### Phase 1: Code Quality
- Standardized logging: replaced Debug.WriteLine with SilksongCoopPlugin.LogWarn
- Added XML documentation to ~285+ public APIs
- Fixed 4 inappropriate null-forgiving operators

### Phase 2: Code Navigation
- Added #region blocks to all 26 files >200 lines
- Organized code into logical sections: Fields, Properties, Constructors, Unity Lifecycle, Public Methods, Private Methods, etc.
- Improved code readability and maintainability

**Download:** SilksongCoop_v2.0.6.zip — extract to game folder, overwrite existing files.

**Note:** This is a maintenance release with no gameplay changes. All 614 tests passing.
name: v2.0.6 - Code Restructuring
